Name: Eshton
Summary: Son of Mehir and father of Beth-rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:11: Son of Mehir and father of Beth-rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Eshton stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
